The world air network: who is left out

3,218 airports and 36,906 routes from OpenFlights. Every dot is one airport; the colour is its fragility. The hubs feed the network, but at its edges sit territories that depend on a single link.

ScoreAirport Countryk

How the score is built. It is a stated heuristic, not a measurement: isolation 40 pts (k=0 scores 40, k≥5 scores 0) · bottleneck 25 pts (share of airports cut off if it closes, capped at 3) · remoteness 15 pts (hops to the nearest mega-hub, capped at 5) · no alternative 20 pts (its country has no other airport). The network has 333 cut vertices and 69 countries that depend on a single airport.

Source. OpenFlights (ODbL), subset derived by make seed: 3,218 airports with at least one direct route and 36,906 routes. A static, ageing dataset: it reads the structure of the network, not for operational decisions.
